name: Returning Fang Stance
description: Throw a homing Fang that strikes, returns harmlessly, and immediately launches again. Fighting close speeds up its cycle. Attack speed increases flight speed; extra projectiles grant 25% Fang damage each.

name: Twin Fang
description: Every fourth launch sends 2 additional spectral Fangs, seeking different enemies when possible. Spectral Fangs return once and cannot summon more Fangs.

name: Relentless Fang
description: Consecutive hits from the same Fang against an enemy gain 15% damage per hit, up to 75%. Hitting another enemy resets the bonus.

name: Resonant Fang
description: After striking an enemy, each returning Fang releases a burst around you for 50% Fang damage. Bursts cannot trigger Fang effects.

name: Deadeye
description: Fang hits have a 15% chance to deal double damage.

name: Samurai Assist
description: Completed main-Fang round trips have a 5% chance to call Samurai for an assist attack. Can trigger once per second.

name: Splintering Fang
description: Fang kills scatter one kunai for each direct Fang hit the enemy took, including the killing hit. Each kunai deals 40% Fang damage and cannot trigger Fang effects.

name: Fang Damage
description: Fangs deal 20% more damage.

name: Flight Speed
description: Fangs travel 15% faster on outward and return trips.
format: Fangs travel {Percent}% faster on outward and return trips.

name: Attack Range
description: Fangs seek enemies 15% farther away.

name: Close Quarters
description: Fang hits deal 10% more damage to enemies within 3 metres of you.
format: Fang hits deal {Percent}% more damage to enemies within 3 metres of you.

name: Killing Edge
description: Fang hits deal 15% more damage to enemies below 30% health.
format: Fang hits deal {Percent}% more damage to enemies below 30% health.

name: Twin Fang Frequency
description: Twin Fang requires 1 fewer launch, down to every launch.

name: Relentless Pressure
description: Increases Relentless Fang's damage per stack and maximum bonus by 20% of their base values.

name: Resonant Reach
description: Resonant Fang bursts have 15% more radius.

name: Deadeye Mastery
description: Adds 10% critical-hit chance to Fang hits.

name: Reinforcements
description: Adds 5% chance to call Samurai on a completed main-Fang round trip.

name: Splinter Power
description: Splintering Fang kunai deal 20% more damage.

name: Farstrider
description: Fangs travel 25% slower. Outward hits gain damage with distance travelled, up to 150% bonus damage at 10 metres.

name: Redline
description: Fangs travel 60% faster, but deal 30% less damage.

name: Predator's Price
description: Fang critical hits deal 50% more damage, but noncritical hits deal 25% less damage.

name: Attack Damage
description: Ninja attacks deal 20% more damage.

name: Attack Speed
description: Ninja attacks are 15% faster. Converts to Flight Speed with Returning Fang.
format: Ninja attacks are {Percent}% faster. Converts to Flight Speed with Returning Fang.

name: Coverage
description: Kunai and Great Shuriken are 15% larger. Converts to Attack Range with Returning Fang.
format: Kunai and Great Shuriken are {Percent}% larger. Converts to Attack Range with Returning Fang.
